settings.headline: Three strengths of cream. One system.
settings.subhead: UK-formulated topical preparation cream, made for aesthetic appointments. Clinical, Advanced, and Professional. Choose by what you're booking.
settings.image_alt: Editorial still life of all three Senseless cream tubes on a warm off-white background

settings.label: Clinical Strength
settings.heading: For routine appointments
settings.body: The everyday Senseless cream. Used for top-ups, routine microneedling, smaller laser zones, and semi-permanent makeup retouches. Available in 10g and 30g. Quietly capable.
settings.image_alt: Clinical Strength Senseless cream on a warm off-white background

settings.label: Advanced Strength
settings.heading: For longer, more demanding sessions
settings.body: Higher concentration, formulated for full-face laser, deeper microneedling, more sensitive treatment areas, or sessions where you want more from your preparation. 10g and 30g.
settings.image_alt: Advanced Strength Senseless cream on a warm off-white background

settings.label: Professional Strength
settings.heading: Developed with practitioners
settings.body: Our most concentrated formula. Used in clinics across the UK. Available without restriction in 30g. Professional sits at the top of the Senseless cream range. Trusted at the chair.
settings.image_alt: Professional Strength Senseless cream on a warm off-white background

settings.headline: Or by what you're booking next.
A topical preparation cream. Formulated for the chair.
settings.body: Senseless cream is a UK cosmetic product. A topical preparation developed specifically for the kind of sessions modern aesthetic clinics actually run. The cream sits in three concentrations, formulated to match the demands of different procedures. The 30g size suits most personal regimens. The 10g size suits a single appointment, travel, or trying a tier before committing.

settings.headline: All Senseless cream.
settings.body: Three cream strengths. Clinical and Advanced come in 30g and 10g; Professional in 30g. Choose your size on the product page.

settings.headline: What comes next.
settings.body: Most aesthetic appointments end with a treated area that needs gentle handling. The Senseless Foaming Cleanser is built for the hours after. An antibacterial cleansing foam that respects what you just had done.
settings.image_alt: Editorial image of the Senseless Foaming Cleanser on a clean countertop

settings.question: Which strength should I choose?
settings.answer: Clinical for routine appointments. Advanced for longer or more sensitive sessions. Professional for the most demanding indications. See the strength guide for the full breakdown.

settings.question: When do I apply it?
settings.answer: Apply ahead of your appointment. Specific timing depends on the procedure and how you respond to topical preparations — your practitioner is the best guide for the appointment you've booked.

settings.question: Can I use it for tattoos?
settings.answer: Senseless is formulated for aesthetic procedures. For body art, see our topical numbing for body art guide.

settings.question: Is Senseless cruelty-free?
settings.answer: Certification is pending — we'll confirm this here once verified.

settings.question: Is this a medicine?
settings.answer: No. Senseless is a UK cosmetic product. Not a medicine. Not a pharmacy product.

settings.question: What size should I buy?
settings.answer: 30g suits most personal regimens. 10g suits a single appointment, travel, or trying a tier before committing to the larger size.
